description: This Java class 'FinalPrice' models price information for a product, including original price, discounted price, final price, discount details, and related metadata, mainly used for display purposes in a catalog.

classes.name: FinalPrice
classes.description: A transient entity class representing various pricing details for a product.

methods.name: getAdditionalPrices
methods.description: Returns the list of additional prices associated with this price object.

methods.name: setAdditionalPrices
methods.description: Sets the list of additional prices associated with this price object.

methods.name: getOriginalPrice
methods.description: Returns the original price of the product.

methods.name: setOriginalPrice
methods.description: Sets the original price of the product.

methods.name: getDiscountEndDate
methods.description: Returns the end date of the discount period.

methods.name: setDiscountEndDate
methods.description: Sets the end date of the discount period.

methods.name: isDiscounted
methods.description: Indicates if the product is discounted.

methods.name: setDefaultPrice
methods.description: Sets whether this is the default price.

methods.name: isDefaultPrice
methods.description: Checks if this is the default price.

methods.name: setProductPrice
methods.description: Associates a ProductPrice object with this price.
